The problem this solution exists for
Quality escapes are discovered by customers; yield losses accepted as normal; energy lacks per-unit truth; root cause takes weeks.
Our approach

We unify process/quality/energy telemetry with lineage, deploy vision and process models closing loops into line systems, and instrument the cost-per-unit metrics that operations leadership steers by.
Components

items: Inspection closing into andon and holds
Loss decomposition by stage and cause

blocks.x: Platform stack

The solution runs on Dataq Twinverse and Dataq Forge: Sensor data feeds a living model of your plant, fleet or field estate, and the model drives action. The governed data estate every AI program needs.

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.

Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: Industry fit
Deployed across Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
